Episode 163. Return to the Clan (1)
February 10, 1803. It's been five days since Jin visited Gyeogoksae Castle.

During those five days, Jin had the chance to hear in detail about the events of the past two years and six months from his companions. Changes in the global landscape, advancements in technology, the situation of each power, etc.
Most of it was information he had heard before going to Gyeogoksae Castle, but with more details added.
For example, these kinds of information.

Kinzelo has secured a new headquarters to replace the 'old headquarters' in the land of the Beastmen and recruited many demons like Lanke. Ziphel is restructuring a new system throughout the 'Rutero Magic Federation,' closing all Magic Towers except for one.

Furthermore, the royal family was incorporated into Ziphel along with the eastern part of the empire, and like all factions affiliated with the Rutero Magic Federation, they received technology from Ziphel and are operating a number of fleets.
Even the 'enhanced humans' like the fleet, Mines, Myeongins, and biological golems are using a technology called chaos control.
Meanwhile, the only ones not using chaos at all were the Barmel Alliance and their friendly forces.

"While you were away, Sir Dante has made great efforts. Without Dante, the empire would have either all gone to Ziphel or been divided among various factions, not just the East," Kazimir said humbly. But in reality, the reason why the 'Chaos Rejection Faction' has been safe so far was largely due to the roles of the Barmel Alliance, Bigu, and the Holy Kingdom.
Barmel Alliance, Bigu, Hairan, and the Holy Kingdom. These representative chaos rejection factions were leaning on each other for support.
"In an era where airships and chaos control are common, the only true technological advancement has been ours," Kazimir said.
The technological power of Ziphel and Kinzelo was actually just coming to light.
Of course, there had been developments regarding chaos control, but producing airships was possible even before.

In contrast, the Barmel Alliance not only manufactured airships but achieved a technological revolution called 'wave tracking mobile space leap,' and even prepared a means to completely purify chaos in certain situations.
While other factions might be able to use chaos, they couldn't even attempt to purify it.
From the beginning, their research was aimed at using chaos rather than purifying it.
"Yes, master."
"Meanwhile, Runekandel has been isolating the city of Calon and hiding all its external activities since half a year ago..."
Runekandel.
Regarding them, once one of the two great powers, Tikan had hardly learned anything during Jin's absence.
Their activities had become closed-off, there had been seven explosions and earthquakes, and the only thing they had managed to capture were indications that they were controlling the news about Jin.

"Even from half a year ago, there's hardly any known external activity from the Knights. Occasionally, there are articles about them subjugating the remnants of the polluted area and the infected, but they do not show themselves on the official stone records."
"Defus, Meri, Tona brothers.
Even the four knights who could be said to be friendly with Jin and who currently remain in the Sword Garden had no news at all based on that point in time.
Even before then, they often came to Tikan like Yona and asked about Jin's news.
"And as I mentioned before, all the ways we can contact the friendly knights first from our side have been blocked. Even when the knights came, I didn't hear any special stories about the family..."
"Even if there were problems in the family, they couldn't spread it outside. I would have done the same."
Although it's true that the 4th, 7th, 10th, and 11th Knights are friendly with Jin, they're not complete allies.
This is because Jin always kept a certain distance from them.
He had no choice but to do so. The Tona brothers may not know, but the rest were competitors no matter how close they were.
- Maybe soon your sister will be able to find a small clue about Temar's fifth tomb.
- Runatia Sister? Somehow, I heard that Defus Brother is in charge of preventing chaos, not Runatia Sister. She was looking for Temar's tomb. It's surprising that it would help you.
- There may have been information you didn't know about in Runecandel. The third knight is moving based on that.
The last news about Runatia, another well-intentioned competitor, was related to Temar's fifth tomb.
Valeria is also tracking Temar's tomb while purifying the society of little people, and she had found a crucial clue from the route and traces left by Runatia.
That's why she hasn't returned to Tikan yet, even after Jin returned.
'My father and Luna sister, the expedition, will still be in the Black Sea. And... there's a chance they may have already fallen.'
I can't help but hope that's not the case.
Jin swallowed a sigh and looked at his colleagues.
"We should probably assume that the family has gone to the prophet and move accordingly."
Otherwise, there were only situations that were hard to understand.
"So... don't you plan to return to the Sword Garden?"
"No, I need to go back and check for myself."
"It's too dangerous, sir."
"Lord, I think so too. How about watching a little more?"
The colleagues who watched the Smarion War had no doubt that Jin's martial art had reached a level that could be called the strongest.
Nevertheless, going to Runecandel alone was dangerous. If the Prophet really seized the family, Runecandel would naturally set a trap to catch Jin.
No matter how dangerous Smarion was, it was nothing compared to the entire Runecandel.
"Of course, I will watch the situation once. But I can't watch for long."
"Is it because of your promise with Rosa? If you've already determined that the family has gone to the prophet, you don't need to keep the three-year deadline that Rosa gave you."

"That's not the reason, Lord Quicantel. I have two reasons for wanting to go to the family. The first is to properly check the situation of the family, and the second is because they still don't know my power."
If there is no particular problem with the first reason. If the reason the family is hiding themselves is just because they are catching their breath.
Jin can then prepare to ascend to the lord of Runecandel in earnest.
Either by naturally inheriting power or by forcibly pulling her down.
However, if the prophet's control is clearly revealed in the verification process, Jin has to classify 'Prophet's Runecandel' as an enemy and wage war from that point.

"...I have to inflict as much damage as possible when the family doesn't know my power. If the prophet has swallowed the family and the reason they are holding their breath is simply to get new information from me."
"Do you mean to fight on the spot immediately if things go wrong?"
"That's right."
"This is no different from the old Murakan. What if you encounter a trap you can't handle?"
"I have to escape. I'll need help from the Red Owl Clan and Mot."
"...Well, luckily it's not really like the old Murakan. If it were Murakan, he would have said that there is nothing in the world that can stop him."

"I know what you, Lord Quicantel, and the colleagues are worried about. But I can't just continue to reconsider from the outside without knowing the exact situation in Runecandel. If the power of the prophet keeps getting stronger in the meantime, eventually I really won't be able to handle it."
If the prophet is just accumulating power while controlling the family, he must strike as soon as possible, even a day earlier.
To some extent, he must take the risk. Jin was thinking that way.

"Also, even if the family has gone to the prophet, I don't think everything is in that state. There must be those who are resisting, and we must rescue them before they are finished and include them in our forces."
Defus and Meri, Tona brothers. It was a statement with those four people in mind.
"Hoo."
Quicantel and his colleagues sighed. It wasn't a sigh because they thought Jin's words were wrong.

Even though Jin had returned so strong, and despite the Bamul Alliance's many advancements. The fact that they were still in a disadvantaged position and had no choice but to make a risky decision was frustrating.
The best outcome is that the family is intact, but the chances of that are very low.

"Don't overthink it, everyone. After all, it's a matter we're bound to face, and fortunately, we've achieved a considerable amount of what we wanted in the past two years and six months. And even if the family has turned over to the Prophet, one thing is clear: we are at an advantage."
The new information that Jin had obtained.
Assuming that the Prophet had devoured the family, the only reason Lundell did not pressure Tikan was probably that.
"First, let the world know that I've returned. Let's see how the family reacts."
"And then?"
"If possible, please contact Beradin. The large forces will definitely know more about Lundell than us, and with luck, we might be able to hear something."
"I'll try, but it's best not to expect it. Duke Beradin has not been active outside since the Gongja began his training."
Jin nodded with a bitter face.
"……Then we'll have to give up on Beradin. I mean, if Beradin and Sandra don't come looking for me when they find out I'm back, it's only right to assume they've got problems."
"I'll also contact Bi-gung today... Oh, it looks like Mote is coming."

Outside the window, the white dimensional door of the bullfrog Mote was just opening. Mote seemed very tired. There were some restrictions on Mote's dimensional movement after the birth of chaos particles.
"Son-in-law! Do I have to find you first right after I come? Even if it's the era when the teleportation gate disappeared."
As soon as she realized that Smarion had been subjugated, she came looking for Tikan.
"It's been a while, Lord Talalis. I was just about to talk to you……."
"Hmm, I'm sure it's a request. Are you thinking of going to Lundell?"
Talalis recognized Jin's intention even before he spoke.
"Yes."
"I was worried you would be filled with confidence from capturing Smarion and go alone without me. Let's catch up on the backlog of stories first."
From that day on, Tikan immediately announced Jin's return to the world. Reporters led by Dino Jeglun tirelessly released special news, none of which involved Lanke and Smarion.
Instead, they spread false advertisements that Dante had subdued Smarion.
It was better to hide Jin's power until he went to Lundell, and it was more advantageous to advertise Dante's power in many ways.
Lundell did not make a special position on Jin's return.
Instead, they unexpectedly released a special report claiming they had found a 'relic of the first owner'....
Until then, Tikan had not received any contact from Valeria.
